# Pure Grain Exports

> B2B wholesale leather hides and OEM finished leather goods supplier based in Lahore, Pakistan.

Pure Grain Exports (SMC-Private) Limited supplies full-grain cowhide, buffalo hide, and goat skin to international manufacturers and brands. We also produce OEM/private-label finished leather goods (wallets, belts, bags, jackets, backpacks) for wholesale buyers.

## Products
- [Wholesale Leather Hides](https://www.puregrainexports.com/catalog/raw-leather): Full-grain cowhide, buffalo, goat — sold per sq ft
- [OEM Leather Goods](https://www.puregrainexports.com/catalog/finished-products): Private-label manufacturing of wallets, belts, bags

## Key Information
- [About](https://www.puregrainexports.com/about): Company overview
- [Quality Process](https://www.puregrainexports.com/quality): How we ensure consistency
- [Payment & Trade Terms](https://www.puregrainexports.com/payments-and-trade-terms): LC, TT, PayPal accepted
